spans.s: + गन्ध योजन- + गन्ध, f. धा, 1. musk. 2. a name of Sītā and Satyavatī.

योजन, i. e. युज् + अन, n.
 1.
. A means for inducing (the gods) to yoke (their horses and to come),

. A measure of distance of about five or nine miles, Pañc. 226, 9.
 --Comp.

योजयितृ, i. e. युज्, Caus., + तृ, m., f. त्री, n.
 1. Who or what joins.
 2. One who enchases, Hit. ii. d. 71.
